title: Tenure, Dunleer, Co. Louth, A92V1H3
description:
Magnificent 4 bedroom detached family residence situated at the heart of Tenure, Dunleer, Co. Louth. Upon arrival you will appreciate the wonderful atmosphere created by its present owners with the entire house tastefully decorated and maintained to an excellent standard throughout. The accommodation consists of light filled rooms that are well-proportioned, and are complimented outside by the large landscaped gardens to the front & rear, including a private west facing rear aspect. With easy access to Drogheda Town Centre within 15 minute’s drive & the M1 Motorway less than 8 minutes, this is a quality home ideal for any purchaser who requires a property tastefully finished and ready to go. To appreciate this truly magnificent family residence, viewing is essential.
